messages:
linda: Thanks for coming to the all-hands earlier—quick live follow-up thread on the hiring & org updates. I'll be answering questions for ~30m, and Raj (People) will add details on prioritization and timelines. Ask anything about headcount, team moves, or backfills.

mike: Is there a company-wide hiring freeze or just a slowdown?

linda: Not a freeze. We're pausing a small number of non-core contractor roles and reprioritizing open reqs toward product, infra, and SRE for the next two quarters. Net hiring target is lower than last year but still positive for strategic roles.

anya: For teams that are being split (product -> Platform / Experience), will managers stay with their current teams or move with ICs?

linda: Managers will generally stay aligned to the functional org (product/plat/experience) to own north-star metrics. ICs will be moved into squads where their work best matches the roadmap; we'll try to minimize manager churn. Timeline is rolling over the next 4–6 weeks.

raj: Quick add—we've published a prioritization matrix (DM me if you don't have the link). Hiring focus order: 1) Core infra & SRE, 2) Product-facing engineers for money-making workflows, 3) Key ML infra roles. Hiring coordinators should expect updated job slots by EOD Friday.

sophie: Does this mean some open reqs will be canceled? What happens to candidates in progress?

linda: Some low-priority reqs may be paused; candidates already mid-process will be evaluated and either advanced or given recruiter reach-outs to explain next steps. We won't ghost active candidates.

devon: Will total headcount targets be public to the company or just managers/leadership?

linda: We'll share quarter-level hiring targets with the company (high-level numbers, not per-person approvals). Managers will get the granular slot lists they need for planning.

mike: Any changes to interview loop or hiring bar? Curious if we'll loosen bar to hit numbers.

linda: No. We are keeping the bar consistent. We will streamline interview logistics and improve rubrics to reduce false negatives, but no change to quality expectations.

anya: How does Dedicated and Private product staffing get prioritized compared to Hosted API work?

raj: Product priority is driven by revenue and customer SLAs. Hosted/Platform (reliability, infra) and Dedicated (enterprise SLA work) are both high priority; Private/on-prem will be staffed for strategic enterprise deals. Teams should talk to product leads if they have specific case needs.

people-bot: Reminder — anyone owning open reqs must update Greenhouse tags by Friday per new prioritization.

sophie: Will there be layoffs or downsizing in any org? Heard rumors.

linda: No layoffs planned. The changes are a reprioritization and targeted pauses on certain non-core contractor hires. If anything changes, we'll communicate transparently.

devon: For those impacted by role moves, is there a transition policy (shadowing, ramp time)?

linda: Yes—each reassignment includes a 2–4 week overlap plan, a clear onboarding doc, and a success checklist. People Ops will coordinate transition allowances and managers will set expectations.

mike: Timeline recap?

linda: Prioritization list out by Friday. Role move plans announced over the next 2 weeks. Most reassignments completed in 4–6 weeks. Hiring adjustments apply immediately for new req approvals.

anya: Thanks—appreciate the clarity.

linda: Thanks for the questions. If you have something private, DM Raj or your manager. We'll keep this thread open for a bit. :thumbsup:
